products.name: Sur-Ron 70/100-19 OEM Front Tire
products.notes: Sold out per batch flag. NOTE: page metadata on 2026-10-11 showed InStock - re-check before purchase. Tire only; tube sold separately. OEM for Light Bee / Light Bee X.

products.name: E Ride Pro 18-Inch Fatty Rear Tire
products.notes: 100/90-18 rear tire for SS3.0/SR. Tire only; tube not included.

products.name: Rippin Moto 70/100-19 Performance Duty Inner Tube
products.notes: Replaces the E Ride Pro E7254 tube (official page 404s - likely discontinued). 2mm heavy-duty 2.75/3.00-19 tube, TR4 valve, pressure-tested.

products.name: Talaria Sting MX3/MX4 OEM CST Front Tire
products.notes: Item [1] on Zeal Racing's Talaria Sting front-wheel OEM parts page; listed Sold Out. Tire only.

products.name: Plews MX2 Matterly GP Rear Tire
products.notes: Price verified $99, in stock. Confirm the tire size matches the installed 16-inch rear wheel and intended terrain.

products.name: Shinko 244 Dual Sport Tire
products.notes: DOT dual-sport (70% street / 30% dirt), 4-ply tube-type. Popular budget street-legal option for Sur-Ron-class bikes; 2.75-19 fits stock 19" rims. Stamped 'Golden Boy SR 244'.

products.name: Kenda K270 Dual Sport Tire
products.notes: DOT dual-sport (50/50 street/dirt), tube-type. Huge size run from pit-bike to full-size; dedicated front and rear styles. Price varies by size.

products.name: Tusk Dsport Adventure Tire
products.notes: DOT aggressive dual-sport with tall knobbies (16mm rear / 11.5mm front tread depth). RM house brand. Sizes skew to full-size bikes; no small e-moto wheel sizes.

products.name: Kenda Millville II K785 Tire
products.notes: Soft-to-intermediate MX knobby with excellent pit-bike size coverage (12"/14"/16" rears). DOT-rated only in 21" front sizes; smaller sizes are NHS. Model K785 (not K778).

products.name: Shinko 525 Cheater Rear Tire
products.notes: Hybrid enduro rear: soft sticky trials-style rubber on a moto carcass for rocks/roots. Rear only, no front version. NHS (not for highway). Listed at MotoSport as R525 Cheater.

products.name: Dunlop Geomax MX34 Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX race tire with Progressive Cornering Block Technology. Very wide size run incl. minis (10"/12"/14"). Competition tire, no DOT approval. Price varies by size.

products.name: Michelin StarCross 6 Medium Soft Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX tire with silica compound. Fronts 80/100-21, 90/100-21; rears 100/90-19 through 120/90-18. NHS. Full-size run only.

products.name: Pirelli Scorpion MX32 Mid Soft Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX tire with wide size run incl. minis. RevZilla flags this listing as discontinued (2025 MX32 update) — still purchasable in most sizes but stock thinning. No DOT approval.

products.name: Kenda K760 Trakmaster II Tire
products.notes: DOT-approved knobby (10% road / 90% off-road), 6-ply tube-type. Best small-wheel coverage of any DOT knobby: 10"/12"/14"/16"/17"/18"/19"/21". Pit-bike front/rear labeling varies by vendor — verify before ordering.

products.name: Bridgestone Battlecross X31 Tire
products.notes: Intermediate-terrain MX race tire: symmetric Castle Block front, asymmetric rear. Full-size run only, NHS (no DOT). Bridgestone mail-in rebate ($50/set) was active through Oct 31, 2026.

products.name: Maxxis Maxxcross MX-SI Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX race tire (co-developed with Jeremy McGrath). Includes e-moto-relevant 90/100-14 rear and 70/100-17 front. NHS, no DOT approval.

products.name: IRC M5B EVO Soft Terrain Tire
products.notes: Rear-focused soft-terrain tire: giant self-cleaning knobs for mud/sand/loam, popular for hill climbs. Rear only (IRC makes a matching 80/100-21 front separately). NHS, not DOT.

products.name: Sur-Ron 19" Off-Road Tire (OEM)
products.notes: Official Sur-Ron OEM replacement knobby, 70/100-19. Page states it fits both front and rear Light Bee wheels. Listed at CAD $109.99 (~$79 USD); ships from Canada.

products.name: CST OEM Take-Off Tire 70/100-19
products.notes: Genuine CST OEM take-offs from new Sur-Ron/Talaria/Segway bikes (new or >=3/4 tread). Budget way to refresh stock rubber. 70/100-19 fits 19" front and rear.

products.name: CST CM713 80/100-19 Rear Tire (Talaria OEM)
products.notes: OEM rear tire for the Talaria Sting (mfr part TM00328800, 49M tube-type, E-marked — road legal in EU, not DOT). Listed at GBP 74.38 (~$99 USD); UK seller ships to US. No US vendor retails it new.

products.name: CST OEM Off-Road Tire 70/100-19
products.notes: Sur-Ron-spec OEM knobby, 70/100-19. Page explicitly lists fitment for E Ride Pro SE/2.0/3.0/SR and Talaria MX5. Listed at 231 PLN (~$58 USD); German vendor, E-marked (not DOT).

products.name: Kenda Washougal III Tire
products.notes: Charged Cycle Works staple for e-motos. CCW weighed: 70/100-19 front 5.3 lb, 90/100-18 rear 8.1 lb, 90/100-16 rear 8.3 lb.

products.name: Mitas Terra Force-MX 16" Rear Tire
products.notes: Super-light 16" rear for the 19/16 supermini setup Charged recommends. CCW weighed the 90/100-16 at 7.8 lb.

products.name: IRC VE33 Rear Tire
products.notes: Hard-terrain rear (100/100-18). CCW weighed it at 9.3 lb. Good match for 18" rear wheels (Storm Bee, Ultra Bee, Komodo).

products.name: Michelin StarCross 5 Front Tire
products.notes: Medium-terrain front (70/100-19). CCW weighed it at 7.1 lb — one of the heavier 19" fronts, but a proven moto tire.

products.name: Tusk T-35 Front Tire
products.notes: Budget soft/intermediate front. CCW weighed the 70/100-19 at 6.1 lb. Sizes down to 10" for pit bikes.

products.name: Tusk T-35 Rear Tire
products.notes: Budget soft/intermediate rear. CCW weighed the 90/100-16 at 8.3 lb.

products.name: Tusk Recon Sticky Tire
products.notes: Sticky-compound race tire for e-motos (not DOT). CCW weighed: 70/100-19 front 6.1 lb, 90/100-16 rear 8.3 lb.

products.name: Tusk Ground Wire eMoto Tire
products.notes: DOT-compliant tire made for OEM 19"/19" e-moto wheels. CCW weighed: 70/100-19 front 5.75 lb, 80/90-19 rear 6.25 lb.

products.name: Bridgestone M203 Front Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate front. CCW weighed the 70/100-19 at 5.5 lb — one of the lightest 19" fronts.

products.name: Bridgestone M204 Rear Tire
products.notes: Rear with pit-bike sizes (16"/14"/12"). CCW weighed the 90/100-16 at 7.5 lb.

products.name: Bridgestone Battlecross X30 Tire
products.notes: CCW weighed: 70/100-19 front 5.7 lb, 90/100-16 rear 8.2 lb.

products.name: Dunlop MX33 Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX tire. CCW weighed: 70/100-19 front 5.8 lb, 90/100-16 rear 8.4 lb.

products.name: Dunlop MX53 Tire
products.notes: Intermediate/hard-terrain MX tire. CCW weighed the 70/100-19 at 6.3 lb. Note: the 90/100-16 rear runs wide and may need wheel dishing.

products.name: Shinko SR241 Trials Tire
products.notes: DOT-compliant trials tire, front or rear. Huge size run from 12" to 21". CCW weighed the 2.75-19 at 6.4 lb.

products.name: IRC IX-09 Gekkota Gummy Tire
products.notes: Hard-enduro gummy rear — not for MX use. 90/100-16 in stock; 18"/21" variants were out of stock.
